ticket: Hi, I'm really sorry to reach out like this, but our payment method failed and now both my coworker and I are locked out of the workspace. We’ve tried everything, but the system says we’re suspended. This is urgent—we can’t work on client projects without access. I know it’s on us to update the card, but we’re both completely blocked now. Could you please help us get back in?

Hi Northbeam support, I'm writing to report that our entire team is currently unable to access the Northbeam platform—every member of our construction project management team, including myself, is getting a 503 Service Unavailable error when trying to log in, and the login page itself is not loading at all. We’ve tried from multiple devices and networks, including mobile data and different browsers, and the issue persists across all of them. We're currently unable to update project timelines, assign tasks, or track material deliveries, which is severely impacting our on-site operations. This has been ongoing for about 45 minutes now, and we’ve confirmed that no one in the company can get in, so it’s not an individual account issue.

Hi, I need to request a complete data export for my teammate Sarah Chen, who’s leaving the company. We need her full activity and project history for compliance purposes before her last day—please confirm when we can get the full dataset.

Our workspace is suspended because of a failed payment, and we’re now locked out of Northbeam—this is critical because we can’t track fulfillment timelines or send shipping updates to customers, and we’re already behind on orders; also, the new dashboard layout is completely unusable and hides the critical metrics we need, but that’s secondary to the fact that we’re literally unable to operate without access right now.
All my team, including my assistant Mark, cannot open Northbeam — every time we try to log in, we get a blank screen. Is the system down for everyone?

We're preparing for GDPR compliance and would like to request a full export of all personal data associated with our Northbeam account, including patient notes and appointment histories, as we're considering migrating to another platform. Could you please send us a copy of our data in a structured format?
I received invoice #NB-78945-2024 for March, but tax code is wrong — should be 8.5% not 7.2%. Can you send corrected document?

Hi, I am IT admin for nonprofit named GreenFuture, we use SSO for Northbeam. Today I saw login activity from location I do not know, it is a city in Turkey, but no one from our team is there. Also, I found that someone changed the two-factor authentication setting to disable it, and also changed the email address linked to the admin account to a different one. I cannot access the account now because I do not have access to that new email. This is very serious, I think someone hacked our account. The order number is NB-773382-911, please help fast.
The login page is showing a 503 error for everyone in the company—our entire team is locked out, and invoice #NB-789441 won’t let us process payments.
We need a way to set custom statuses for tasks, like 'waiting on client' or 'on hold'. Can you please tell me how long it will take to add this feature?

Hi, I'm the office manager at SmileCare Dental, and I'm unable to log in to our Northbeam account. I keep getting stuck in a password reset loop, and I’ve lost my 2FA authentication device. I’ve tried using the 'forgot password' option multiple times, but it just sends me back to the login screen. I need to update patient billing records today, so this is blocking my work. Could you help me regain access?

Logged in from a new IP in Nigeria this morning, my 2FA settings were changed to backup codes, can't access my own account, previous password no longer works, changed security settings without my consent, need help locking this out and regaining control

Hi, we just noticed our workspace is showing as suspended due to a failed payment, and my co-founder Sam is unable to access the account to fix it—our billing is currently stuck. Could you please help us resolve this quickly so we don’t lose access to client data?

Hey, I just noticed this invoice #NB-789123 from February 14th says $899.50 for the annual Pro plan, but I thought we were on the Starter plan until March, and also there’s a $45 tax line item that doesn’t make sense because we’re based in Oregon and we don’t have state sales tax—maybe it’s a glitch, or did you start charging us extra without telling us? Also, I’ve been meaning to ask, can you send me the tax document for last year again? My accountant said we need it for the audit, and I think it’s buried in the old emails. Anyway, we did a bunch of jobs last month and I’m trying to get our books in order, so this would help a lot—just wondering if this charge is correct or if I need to fix something on my end?
Hi, our whole team cannot use Northbeam anymore. I try to log in and get 503 error. Also Maria from marketing is stuck—she sees same error. Everyone in office has same problem. Please fix fast.
We need a way to auto-tag orders based on product categories, so we can generate reports without manual work. Can you add this feature please?
Payment failed. Workspace suspended. Need to reactivate ASAP. How long until fix? Can't onboard new clients.

I’m so sorry to bother you with this, but we’ve been using Northbeam for our practice scheduling and patient tracking for the past year, and I’ve just realized we’re missing a critical feature—our team really needs the ability to generate custom report templates for insurance claims, specifically one that pulls patient history, procedure codes, and appointment dates in a format that matches our billing software. I know this isn’t a bug or a crash, and I’ve tried using the current export tools, but they’re not flexible enough—we’re manually reformatting data every week, which is taking hours and increasing the risk of errors. I completely understand if this is on a roadmap, but I wanted to flag it urgently since our new insurance provider is requiring these reports by next month, and we’re already behind. I’ve seen other practices use similar tools with this feature, so I’m hopeful you might consider adding it soon. I’ve attached a mockup of the format we need, and my invoice number is NB-884312 for your records.

Hi, I'm sorry to bother you, but I need to request a full export of all my personal data from Northbeam as part of our GDPR compliance update. I’ve already sent a previous request, but I just realized I missed including some client notes—I’d really appreciate it if you could include those too. Also, the calendar sync has been lagging a bit lately, but it’s not urgent.

Hi, I just received my quarterly tax summary report and noticed the VAT amount doesn't match what I expected—could you help clarify how it was calculated and when I can expect the final version to be available?

I am very worried because I cannot access my Northbeam account anymore — I tried to reset password three times but each time the system sends me to login page again and I see error message 'invalid credentials' even if I enter correct password, and I also lost my 2FA device last week, now I cannot get any code, my team leader says I must finish the monthly performance report today but I am stuck, I know there is another tool called WorkFlowPro that has better support and faster login, but we still use Northbeam and I hope you can help me before we switch to them.

Hey, I can’t log in and neither can Mike—his phone’s been acting up too, but he says the login page just gives a 503 error like mine. We’ve both been trying for 45 minutes and the whole shift planning is stuck. I don’t know if it’s a server thing or if our accounts are borked, but we can’t even get the app open. The team’s waiting on me to assign shifts, and I’m just staring at a blank screen. This isn’t just me—Mike’s on the same network, same problem.

Hey, so I’ve been using Northbeam for our appointment scheduling, and it’s been great, but I keep thinking—why can’t we just drag and drop patients between days like we do with calendar apps? Like, Sarah in reception is always having to rebook things manually, and we’ve had two double-bookings this week because she’s busy with the phone. It’d save so much time if we could just move appointments around easily. I know it’s not a big deal, but I thought I’d mention it since it’s been bugging me for ages.
I just noticed I was charged twice for my monthly plan this month—can you please issue a refund for the duplicate payment? I'm really sorry to bother you with this, but it's throwing off my books.

Hello, I am warehouse supervisor and I cannot enter my Northbeam account anymore, I try to login but every time I put my password, it say error and send me back to login page, I try to reset password but the email not come, I lost my 2FA device and now I cannot work, my team wait for me to set shift schedule, I need help before 5pm today, my order number is NB-77329-45, please fix this fast, I cannot do my job without access

Hi, we're having an issue with the task assignments not syncing properly in Northbeam — it's been happening for two days now, and my teammate Sarah is affected too. We're using the 'assign to me' button as a workaround, but it's not reliable and we're falling behind on order fulfillment. The boards are showing outdated assignees, and it’s causing confusion across the ops team. We can still work around it, but it’s slowing us down significantly.

The entire team is completely locked out—no one can log in, the login page just spins forever and returns a 503 error, and we’ve tried from multiple devices and networks; our whole project tracking is dead, and we have critical site meetings starting in two hours with no way to pull up schedules or resource allocations, so I need to know exactly how long it’s going to take to fix this, because we’re already late and can’t afford another delay.
Hello, I need to delete all data from my account because I am leaving the company. Can you tell me how long it will take to complete this request? Also, please confirm when the data is fully erased.

Hello, all team members cannot login to Northbeam now. Website show error 503. We use SSO with Okta. Yesterday everything was fine. Today no one can access, even admin. Please help fast. Order #NB-88291-445 is affected.

I’m really sorry to bother you, but I’ve been locked out of our Northbeam account and can’t get back in—my password reset loop keeps failing, and I’ve lost my 2FA device, so I can’t complete authentication. I’m the only one managing SSO for our nonprofit, and we rely on Northbeam for tracking our grant projects, so this is blocking all progress. I’ve tried everything, and I’m desperate to regain access as soon as possible.

I have problem with shift scheduling in Northbeam app, every time I try to save new shift, it shows error message 'Could not save shift, please try again' even when I fill all fields correctly, and I must repeat this three or four times before it works, it is very slow and I waste lot of time every day, also I notice that when I open calendar view, sometimes old shifts from last month appear on wrong days, but this is not serious, I can still work with it, only minor annoyance.

I need a way to map custom SSO attributes from our identity provider to specific user roles in Northbeam—right now it’s just using the email and I can’t enforce permissions properly; we’re a nonprofit with strict access rules and this is a dealbreaker for us, so please add support for attribute-based role mapping in SSO settings
Northbeam down for everyone. Can't log in, 503 errors. Boards blank. No one on team can access. Also, calendar sync failed again but that's minor.

Hello, I am IT admin for nonprofit called Green Future, we use SSO with Google for all users. Today I try to login but when I click on Google button, it says error 503 and redirect to login page again. I try many times, even from different computer, but same problem. Also my 2FA device was broken last week and I cannot use it now. My colleague said that only me have this problem, other users work fine. I need help to access my account because I must update the payroll system before deadline, and I have order number 987654321 for invoice #INV-2024-789 that I need to confirm today.
Can't log in. Password reset loop. Lost 2FA device. SSO says I'm not in the org. Tried everything. Competitor has better auth flow.
I need all my data exported immediately—my patient records, appointment history, and billing info—because I’m switching to a different system. How long will this take?

Hey, we just got a panic email from Northbeam saying our account is suspended because the card on file failed, but I swear we paid the April invoice last week—my assistant just sent the payment receipt and everything, and now we can’t even access our appointment schedules, which is a disaster because we have six patients scheduled for this morning and no one can see the calendar, and I don’t know why it’s failing when we already paid, the system must be broken or something.

Hey, so I’ve been using Northbeam for our project timelines and it’s been okay, but honestly, I’m frustrated because we have to manually update progress percentages every week—like, can’t you just auto-calculate based on completed tasks? Also, I saw that Competitor X has a cool feature where you can drag and drop tasks between projects in a single click. We’re thinking about switching because we’re losing time on admin. It’d be great if Northbeam added that. Oh, and can you make the mobile app not crash when I try to upload a photo? (But that’s a side thing.)
We need a way to send patient appointment reminders automatically by SMS, like your competitor does. We are thinking to switch to them because Northbeam doesn't have this feature yet.

Hi, so we just switched to SSO for Northbeam and now neither me nor Sarah from finance can log in—she’s been trying for 30 minutes and keeps getting stuck on the redirect. I’ve double-checked the SSO settings and they look right, but it’s like the system doesn’t recognize our accounts anymore. We’re blocked from working—she’s got client invoices due today and I need to update the project timeline. We don’t have a workaround, and I’ve tried clearing cache, different browsers, even logged in from a different device. This is killing our workflow and we’re not sure what’s going on.

Hi there, I'm reaching out because the shift calendar in the Northbeam app has been displaying time slots with slight misalignments—specifically, the start times for afternoon shifts occasionally appear shifted by 15 minutes, which makes it hard to plan staff coverage accurately. I’ve noticed this consistently over the past three days, and while the actual shift assignments and scheduling are still correct, it’s causing confusion during team huddles when we reference the visual layout. It’s not blocking any work, and I can still create and adjust shifts without issues, but it’s become a minor annoyance when presenting schedules. Also, just a quick note: the notifications for shift changes sometimes take a few extra seconds to appear, but that’s not urgent either.

We need a way to assign tasks to specific team members directly from the mobile app. Right now, we have to go to the desktop to do it, and my assistant, Maria, is always on the field and can't do it. It would help us manage our crews better. Please add this feature soon.
My team cannot use the app because payment failed, and my coworker Anna also has access blocked now. We need to fix this fast, or we cannot schedule shifts for the warehouse.

I need all my data exported immediately — I'm switching to a competitor and I won't leave until I have a full copy of everything. No more delays, no more excuses. I’ve already asked twice. This is my final request.

Hey, so I’m trying to use the new calendar sync feature for our team’s sprint planning, but it’s been adding duplicate events every time I update the board—like, two meetings instead of one. I’ve been manually deleting them after each sync, which is annoying, but it’s not blocking anything since the original events still show up. Also, I was using this for a demo yesterday and had to explain to the client why there were two identical entries. Not ideal, but we’re getting by.
Need full export of all data from my team’s workspace. GDPR compliance audit. How long will this take?

We’ve noticed a discrepancy in our latest invoice—our team has 38 active seats, but the charge reflects 42. Could you please confirm the correct seat count and issue a credit for the overage? We’re evaluating a competitor’s pricing model, so getting this resolved promptly would help us decide whether to stay with Northbeam.

Hi Northbeam team, both my co-founder and I are unable to access our workspace—when we try to log in, we get a blank screen with a 503 error. This has been happening for the past 90 minutes, and we're both blocked from working on client projects. We’ve tried clearing cookies, switching browsers, and confirming our credentials are correct, but nothing works. It’s affecting both of us simultaneously, so it doesn’t seem to be a local or individual issue. Could you please check if there’s a service-wide problem?
Can't log in — password reset loop, 2FA device lost, SSO won't work for me now, also the dashboard loads sideways in Firefox, but that’s minor

Hi, I just noticed my Northbeam account logged in from a location I’ve never used—Lisbon—right after I left work. My colleague Sarah also reported she couldn’t access her dashboard this morning, and both our settings were changed overnight. I’m really worried this isn’t a glitch.
The Northbeam login page is showing a 503 error for everyone in the office—can't access our patient tracking system at all. We're switching to a competitor by Friday if this isn't fixed.

Hi Northbeam support, I'm reaching out on behalf of our team at Summit Builders to request a copy of all personal data associated with my account and also the account of my colleague, Maya Chen, who’s been handling our project timelines. We're preparing for a compliance audit and need to ensure we have full records of data processed through Northbeam, including task logs, file attachments, and any metadata tied to our projects. Maya and I have both been using the platform since January 2023, and we’d like to export all data associated with our accounts for internal review. We understand this is a GDPR/CCPA-style request and are acting proactively to meet regulatory requirements.

Hi Northbeam team, I've really come to rely on your platform for managing client projects and generating invoices, and I wanted to kindly suggest a feature that would make my workflow even smoother—could you please add a 'bulk template' option for invoice templates? Right now, I have to manually copy and paste my standard invoice layout into each new project, which is time-consuming, especially when I'm juggling multiple clients. I’ve also noticed my coworker, Lena from the design team, uses the same setup and has mentioned she’d love this feature too—it’d save both of us hours per week. I know you’re already great at helping us track work, so adding a way to quickly apply consistent invoice templates would be a game-changer for freelancers like us who bill frequently.

Hey, so like, ever since the last update, when I try to add a new task to the board, it just keeps saying 'saving...' and never actually saves, and it's really annoying because my coworker Jamie’s been using the same workaround of copying the task info into a notes field and manually entering it later, but it’s slowing us down a lot even though it kind of works.
Need all data for my account deleted per GDPR. Also, the calendar sync keeps duplicating events, but that’s secondary.
Hi, I am not sure but my account was used from another country. My coworker, Anna, also cannot log in now. She says she did not change anything. The login page shows error. Please help.
Northbeam down for everyone. Login page white screen. Can't access any projects. Team blocked.
SSO login fails for 3 users after recent update. Workaround: manually reset passwords in app. Order #NB-8821-4472 shows no error. Sync back to LDAP is delayed by 45 mins.

I'm so sorry to bother you, but I’m completely blocked from working—my board won’t load at all, and it’s happening for my coworker Jamie too. We both need to submit client invoices by end of day, and we’ve tried restarting, clearing cache, logging out/in, and even using different devices, but nothing works. The dashboard just stays blank and the page never finishes loading. We’ve been stuck like this since this morning, and there’s no way around it—I can’t even export data to submit manually. I know you’re busy, but this is an emergency for us.

we are using Northbeam for our dental practice scheduling and patient tracking, but we miss the ability to add custom fields for patient allergies or special needs, and we can not set up automated reminders for follow-up visits, this is making our staff spend too much time on manual tasks, and we are thinking to switch to another software that has these features because we really need them
Need all my data exported. GDPR request. All project files, messages, task logs. Delete account after.

Hi, I'm the IT admin for a nonprofit using Northbeam, and I'm writing to request a complete data export of all information associated with our organization’s account, as we’re preparing for a mandatory data audit and need to ensure compliance with GDPR and our internal privacy policies. We’ve already reviewed the self-service option but need a full, official archive of all user data, project records, and activity logs for our records. I understand this is a standard request, but we’re under a tight deadline and would appreciate your help in fulfilling this as soon as possible.
